scope: Independent recheck of current repository OCS data; not a complete audit of CMS/HRSA/SEC modules
method: Downloaded 18 individual 2024/2025 OCS insurer annual statement PDFs and 3 Planilla PDFs from embedded original OCS URLs
Read extracted statement pages and Planilla detail/summary tables; matched 77 FY2025 and 50 FY2024 current numeric fields on expected early filing pages
Recomputed core premium and net income aggregates; compared original annual-report summary separately to resolve differing universes

historical_core_reconciliation.reason: Menonita 2024 premium originally filed 707735210 vs 714718421 shown as prior year in 2025 statement. Current site consistently uses 2024 as filed; prior total used Menonita restated number.

findings: Current 2025 core9 premium $17052989443 is supported by individual statements. It is not an OCS total-market figure.
Current 2024 as-filed core9 premium is $15319737318; do not restore $15326720529 absent explicit change to restated baseline.
MCS Advantage 2025 premium $4730861034 and net income $101374716 confirmed on annual statement p4 and OCS annual annex Table2A p10.
Plan Vital 2025 premium is $4994843984 in current Planilla. Older $4947895588 does not match current source.
Planilla2025 detailed claims p2 total $15492767512 differs from summary p8 $15492571266 by $196246, entirely Private Individual Plans. Retain current documented detailed-page basis.

Planilla p8 prints MLR per coverage based on claims PAID divided by premiums WRITTEN. Market ratio 90.16567885055513% is calculated, not an OCS printed total. Avoid interpreting this as regulatory adjusted/incurred MLR.
MCS Life premium includes life and accident/health (Life blank Summary of Operations line1); exclusion of its medical/admin ratios is appropriate.
Planilla insured totals are reported coverage counts. Do not claim independently deduplicated unique residents or directly equate to member-month average enrollment.
2024 vs 2025 Medicare Advantage/Platino coverage-category shifts do not alone demonstrate patient movement; group coverage taxonomy differs from CMS contracts.

Current validation log has 459 rows including 30 live-link checks; headline429 is correct for non-link rows. 392 matches is historic validation result, not proof that every page number has been independently rechecked in this turn.
